title: 隧道管片預鑄與養護~Tunnel-segment precasting and curing
focus: 把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈~Connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads
summary: 本課聚焦把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.anchor: 全環與局部荷載~Ring and local load cases
units.title: 全環與局部荷載~Ring and local load cases
units.mechanism: 預鑄環片完成閉環後承受土水載重，運輸、組裝與推進時卻有不同邊界和集中力。永久環分析不能包辦所有階段，需建立從工廠到受力成環的荷載路徑清單，逐項確認最不利狀態。 假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。~A closed segmental ring carries ground and water loads, while transport, assembly and thrust impose different restraints and concentrated forces. Permanent-ring analysis cannot cover every stage; trace load paths from factory to completed ring. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints.
units.verify: 將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。~List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.
units.failure: 環片在工廠完好卻可能於運輸支點附近開裂，之後裂縫影響水密與耐久；若只審查成環土壓，這種施工階段損傷沒有被設計覆蓋。~Segments sound at the factory may crack near transport supports and later lose watertightness or durability. Reviewing only completed-ring earth pressure leaves that construction-stage damage outside the design assessment.
units.misconception: 永久成環荷載合格就代表運輸和吊運階段必定合格。~Adequate permanent-ring capacity necessarily proves adequate transport and handling performance.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄全環與局部荷載的資料來源與適用條件。將永久、堆放、運輸與推進荷載分列計算工況，檢查支承位置與實際程序一致；以代表性構件試驗或核准分析驗證，任何暫態工況不能因永久承載合格而省略。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for ring and local load cases. List permanent, storage, transport and thrust cases with supports matching actual arrangements; verify through appropriate component tests or approved analysis, retaining temporary cases even when permanent capacity is adequate.

units.anchor: 材料批次與強度~Material batches and strength
units.title: 材料批次與強度~Material batches and strength
units.mechanism: 混凝土強度受配料、含氣、養護和試體代表性影響，單一高強度試塊不代表整批均勻。環片還需控制韌性、密實與尺寸，強度數字只是品質鏈的一部分而非全部驗收證據。 假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。~Concrete strength depends on batching, air, curing and specimen representativeness. One high result does not prove a uniform batch, and toughness, compaction and dimensions remain separate parts of segment quality. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength.
units.verify: 核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。~Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.
units.failure: 試塊養護優於環片會高估實際早齡能力，批號混淆又使低強度件無法追溯；即使平均合格，局部蜂窩和裂縫仍可能控制使用性。~Better specimen curing than segment curing overstates early capacity, while batch confusion prevents tracing weak pieces. A satisfactory mean does not rule out local honeycombing or cracking governing serviceability.
units.misconception: 少量試塊平均強度就是整批環片的特徵設計強度。~The mean of a few specimens is the characteristic design strength of the whole batch.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄材料批次與強度的資料來源與適用條件。核對材料批號、拌合與養護紀錄，將試體時間和對應環片連結；依合約試驗方法評估批次分布，異常值須查成因而非直接刪除，製造及品質主管共同確認處置。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for material batches and strength. Link material, mixing and curing records to specimens and segments by time; evaluate batch distributions under the contract test method and investigate anomalies rather than deleting them, with joint production and quality review.

units.anchor: 纖維與殘餘韌性~Fibres and residual toughness
units.title: 纖維與殘餘韌性~Fibres and residual toughness
units.mechanism: 纖維跨越裂縫後提供殘餘拉力，但效果取決於取向、分布與錨定，不能只由每立方米重量推定。鋼筋和纖維的角色需依設計分清，局部集中力與接縫區仍可能需要專門細節。 假設中央單點載重的三點彎曲缺口梁，殘餘荷重12 kN、跨距0.5 m、寬0.15 m、有效韌帶0.125 m，fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa。 澆置流向造成纖維取向偏差時，標準梁可能比環片不利方向更強；局部纖維團聚又會留下弱區，只看總添加重量無法發現。~Fibres bridge cracks with residual resistance governed by orientation, distribution and anchorage, not dosage alone. Their role relative to reinforcement must be designed, with concentrated loads and joint zones requiring specific detailing. Assume a notched beam under three-point centre loading with residual load 12 kN, span 0.5 m, width 0.15 m and ligament 0.125 m; fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa. Casting-induced fibre orientation can make test beams stronger than the unfavorable segment direction. Local clustering also leaves weak zones that total dosage records alone cannot reveal reliably.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設中央單點載重的三點彎曲缺口梁，殘餘荷重12 kN、跨距0.5 m、寬0.15 m、有效韌帶0.125 m，fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume a notched beam under three-point centre loading with residual load 12 kN, span 0.5 m, width 0.15 m and ligament 0.125 m; fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa.
units.verify: 依適用梁試驗方法記錄裂縫開口與殘餘荷重，對照取樣方向及纖維分布；設計者需確認試驗值如何轉成構件模型，不能把名義纖維添加量直接當拉力設計值。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：澆置流向造成纖維取向偏差時，標準梁可能比環片不利方向更強；局部纖維團聚又會留下弱區，只看總添加重量無法發現。~Record crack opening and residual load using the applicable beam method and check sample orientation and fibre distribution; designers justify transfer to structural behavior rather than converting nominal dosage directly into tensile capacity. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Casting-induced fibre orientation can make test beams stronger than the unfavorable segment direction. Local clustering also leaves weak zones that total dosage records alone cannot reveal reliably.
units.failure: 澆置流向造成纖維取向偏差時，標準梁可能比環片不利方向更強；局部纖維團聚又會留下弱區，只看總添加重量無法發現。~Casting-induced fibre orientation can make test beams stronger than the unfavorable segment direction. Local clustering also leaves weak zones that total dosage records alone cannot reveal reliably.
units.misconception: 纖維添加重量相同就一定產生相同方向的殘餘拉力。~Equal fibre dosage necessarily produces equal residual tensile resistance in every direction.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄纖維與殘餘韌性的資料來源與適用條件。依適用梁試驗方法記錄裂縫開口與殘餘荷重，對照取樣方向及纖維分布；設計者需確認試驗值如何轉成構件模型，不能把名義纖維添加量直接當拉力設計值。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for fibres and residual toughness. Record crack opening and residual load using the applicable beam method and check sample orientation and fibre distribution; designers justify transfer to structural behavior rather than converting nominal dosage directly into tensile capacity.

units.anchor: 模具與幾何公差~Moulds and geometric tolerances
units.title: 模具與幾何公差~Moulds and geometric tolerances
units.mechanism: 環片尺寸決定成環形狀、接縫接觸與止水墊壓縮，累積偏差可能在最後一塊才暴露。模具磨耗及溫度使尺寸隨批次變化，應分辨單件誤差與系統性偏差，不能只檢查能否拼上。 假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。~Dimensions control ring shape, joint contact and gasket compression. Accumulated error may appear only at the final piece, while mould wear and temperature introduce batch drift. Distinguish individual and systematic error rather than accepting mere assembly fit. If an assumed ring has 6 segments each with a same-direction arc-length bias of 0.5 mm, total bias is 3 mm; root-sum-square applies only to independent random errors. Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed ring has 6 segments each with a same-direction arc-length bias of 0.5 mm, total bias is 3 mm; root-sum-square applies only to independent random errors.
units.verify: 以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。~Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.
units.failure: 同向公差若誤當隨機抵消，閉合片可能被迫擠入而造成邊角裂損；反覆修磨又會改變止水墊溝槽，組裝成功仍不代表水密合格。~Treating systematic tolerances as canceling random errors can force the closing piece and crack edges. Repeated grinding may alter gasket grooves, so successful assembly still does not establish watertightness.
units.misconception: 同向尺寸偏差可以和獨立隨機誤差一樣平方根加總。~Same-direction dimensional biases can be combined like independent random errors by root-sum-square.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄模具與幾何公差的資料來源與適用條件。以校準量具或三維量測檢查模具和成品，繪製尺寸隨批次的趨勢並做核准試拼；品質主管須辨識共同偏差，止水溝槽和接觸面公差需與環片設計一致。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for moulds and geometric tolerances. Survey moulds and products with calibrated gauges or three-dimensional methods, chart batch trends and perform approved trial assembly; quality review identifies common bias and aligns groove and bearing-face tolerances with design.

units.anchor: 早齡溫差與養護~Early-age temperature and curing
units.title: 早齡溫差與養護~Early-age temperature and curing
units.mechanism: 水化升溫與外界冷卻形成溫度梯度，受約束收縮可在強度尚低時引起裂縫。高早強不代表低熱裂風險，需同時看溫度歷程、拘束和濕度，避免把養護只等同抗壓數字。 假設α=10⁻⁵/K、E=20 GPa、全約束降溫20 K，彈性拉應力EαΔT=4 MPa；實際徐變會改變結果。 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。~Hydration and cooling create gradients whose restrained contraction can crack young concrete. High early strength does not eliminate thermal risk; temperature history, restraint and moisture must be reviewed alongside compressive results. Assume α=10⁻⁵/K, E=20 GPa and fully restrained cooling of 20 K; elastic tensile stress EαΔT=4 MPa, modified in reality by creep. Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設α=10⁻⁵/K、E=20 GPa、全約束降溫20 K，彈性拉應力EαΔT=4 MPa；實際徐變會改變結果。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume α=10⁻⁵/K, E=20 GPa and fully restrained cooling of 20 K; elastic tensile stress EαΔT=4 MPa, modified in reality by creep.
units.verify: 記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。~Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery.
units.failure: 快速冷卻可使表面先收縮開裂，脫模後乾燥又可能疊加收縮；若只看試塊強度達標便結束養護，耐久缺陷可能在交貨後才明顯。~Rapid cooling contracts the surface first, and post-demoulding drying adds shrinkage. Ending curing solely because specimen strength is reached can leave durability defects that become visible only after delivery.
units.misconception: 早齡抗壓強度高就代表不會發生溫差收縮裂縫。~High early compressive strength guarantees absence of thermal shrinkage cracking.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄早齡溫差與養護的資料來源與適用條件。記錄環片核心和表面溫度、養護濕度及脫模時刻，對照早齡裂縫分布；製造工程師需評估實際拘束與徐變，不能用全約束算例直接判定裂縫一定發生或不發生。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for early-age temperature and curing. Record core-surface temperature, curing moisture and demoulding time and compare early crack patterns; production engineers assess real restraint and creep rather than treating the fully restrained illustration as a definite crack prediction.

units.anchor: 吊運支點與裂縫~Handling supports and cracking
units.title: 吊運支點與裂縫~Handling supports and cracking
units.mechanism: 吊運和堆放的支點控制環片暫態彎矩，位置偏差可比重量誤差更敏感。吊點、墊木和構件方向需要由核准方案決定，教學力學只解釋為何同一環片在不同支承下會有不同應力。 假設簡支示意梁總均布載重20 kN、跨2 m，Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m；曲面環片需專門分析。 墊木錯位可能在外觀未立即開裂時已形成微裂縫，之後推進荷載使其擴展；無交貨前照片時，很難區分製造、運輸與組裝損傷。~Handling and storage supports control transient bending, sometimes more sensitively than weight error. Approved plans govern lifting points, dunnage and orientation; mechanics explains why the same segment develops different stresses under different support arrangements. For an assumed simply supported illustrative beam with total distributed load 20 kN over 2 m, Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m; curved segments require specific analysis. Misplaced dunnage can create microcracking before visible damage, later extended by thrust. Without pre-delivery photographs, manufacturing, transport and assembly damage become difficult to distinguish and address.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設簡支示意梁總均布載重20 kN、跨2 m，Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m；曲面環片需專門分析。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed simply supported illustrative beam with total distributed load 20 kN over 2 m, Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m; curved segments require specific analysis.
units.verify: 核對實際支點與核准圖面，交貨前後保存裂縫和缺角照片並追溯環片序號；吊運由合格團隊按既定程序執行，不能把簡支模型當作吊點選擇或現場操作說明。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：墊木錯位可能在外觀未立即開裂時已形成微裂縫，之後推進荷載使其擴展；無交貨前照片時，很難區分製造、運輸與組裝損傷。~Check actual supports against approved drawings and preserve before-after delivery crack photographs by serial; qualified teams follow approved handling procedures, and the simple beam is not a lifting-point selection or operating instruction. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Misplaced dunnage can create microcracking before visible damage, later extended by thrust. Without pre-delivery photographs, manufacturing, transport and assembly damage become difficult to distinguish and address.
units.failure: 墊木錯位可能在外觀未立即開裂時已形成微裂縫，之後推進荷載使其擴展；無交貨前照片時，很難區分製造、運輸與組裝損傷。~Misplaced dunnage can create microcracking before visible damage, later extended by thrust. Without pre-delivery photographs, manufacturing, transport and assembly damage become difficult to distinguish and address.
units.misconception: 同一環片的吊運支點移動不會改變暫態彎矩。~Moving handling support points cannot change transient bending in the same segment.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄吊運支點與裂縫的資料來源與適用條件。核對實際支點與核准圖面，交貨前後保存裂縫和缺角照片並追溯環片序號；吊運由合格團隊按既定程序執行，不能把簡支模型當作吊點選擇或現場操作說明。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for handling supports and cracking. Check actual supports against approved drawings and preserve before-after delivery crack photographs by serial; qualified teams follow approved handling procedures, and the simple beam is not a lifting-point selection or operating instruction.

units.anchor: 推進千斤頂局部承壓~Local jack bearing
units.title: 推進千斤頂局部承壓~Local jack bearing
units.mechanism: 推進反力透過千斤頂墊板進入環片，局部承壓與劈裂不等同全環均勻軸力。墊板位置、接觸面和平整度決定擴散路徑，偏載可能讓邊緣先損壞而平均壓力仍合理。 假設墊板力1 MN、面積0.1 m²，平均承壓10 MPa；不能代替局部劈裂與邊距檢核。 墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。~Thrust enters through jack pads, creating local bearing and splitting unlike uniform ring compression. Pad location, contact and flatness govern spreading, and eccentricity can damage an edge despite an acceptable mean pressure. An assumed pad force 1 MN over 0.1 m² gives mean bearing 10 MPa; splitting and edge-distance checks remain separate. Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設墊板力1 MN、面積0.1 m²，平均承壓10 MPa；不能代替局部劈裂與邊距檢核。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed pad force 1 MN over 0.1 m² gives mean bearing 10 MPa; splitting and edge-distance checks remain separate.
units.verify: 把千斤頂實際接觸位置與環片配筋模型比較，檢查接觸痕跡及邊緣裂縫；依核准分析或試驗檢核局部荷載路徑，設備與結構負責人共同審查不均勻推力。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。~Compare actual pad positions with reinforcement and analysis, inspecting contact marks and edge cracks; verify local load paths by approved analysis or tests, with joint equipment and structural review of uneven thrust. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage.
units.failure: 墊板只接觸一角會集中壓力並誘發劈裂，總推力除總面積卻可能看似安全；若把裂縫歸於混凝土批次，會漏掉真正的幾何原因。~Corner-only pad contact concentrates pressure and causes splitting while total force divided by total area looks acceptable. Blaming the concrete batch can miss the actual geometric cause of damage.
units.misconception: 千斤頂總推力除總接觸面積足以排除所有局部劈裂。~Total jack force divided by total contact area excludes all local splitting.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄推進千斤頂局部承壓的資料來源與適用條件。把千斤頂實際接觸位置與環片配筋模型比較，檢查接觸痕跡及邊緣裂縫；依核准分析或試驗檢核局部荷載路徑，設備與結構負責人共同審查不均勻推力。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for local jack bearing. Compare actual pad positions with reinforcement and analysis, inspecting contact marks and edge cracks; verify local load paths by approved analysis or tests, with joint equipment and structural review of uneven thrust.

units.anchor: 防火與爆裂驗證~Fire and spalling verification
units.title: 防火與爆裂驗證~Fire and spalling verification
units.mechanism: 火災熱傳、孔壓與材料退化會共同影響環片，表面爆裂使有效厚度減少並暴露配筋。材料小試與足尺受載試驗回答不同問題，防火策略需依隧道用途和設計火災情境評估。 假設熱擴散率a=10⁻⁶ m²/s、時間3600 s，尺度√(at)=0.06 m；不等於爆裂深度或耐火厚度。 把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。~Fire combines heat transfer, pore pressure and material degradation. Spalling reduces effective thickness and exposes reinforcement. Small material tests and loaded full-scale tests answer different questions, requiring a scenario appropriate to tunnel use. Assume thermal diffusivity a=10⁻⁶ m²/s over 3600 s; √(at)=0.06 m is a diffusion scale, not spalling depth or required fire thickness. An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設熱擴散率a=10⁻⁶ m²/s、時間3600 s，尺度√(at)=0.06 m；不等於爆裂深度或耐火厚度。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume thermal diffusivity a=10⁻⁶ m²/s over 3600 s; √(at)=0.06 m is a diffusion scale, not spalling depth or required fire thickness.
units.verify: 核對設計火災曲線、受載狀態、含水及試件尺寸，保留溫度、爆裂和殘餘承載資料；防火工程師依核准性能目標審查，不把單一試驗照片或擴散尺度當耐火認證。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。~Check fire curve, loading, moisture and specimen scale and retain temperature, spalling and residual capacity; fire specialists review approved performance objectives rather than treating one photograph or diffusion scale as certification. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions.
units.failure: 把無載小試直接代表受壓環片可能低估爆裂或接縫效應，保護層局部剝落又使鋼筋快速升溫；忽略試驗邊界會產生錯誤耐火結論。~An unloaded small test may underrepresent spalling or joint effects in loaded segments. Local cover loss also heats steel rapidly, making unexamined test boundaries a source of false fire-resistance conclusions.
units.misconception: 熱擴散尺度就是實際爆裂深度和必需耐火厚度。~Thermal diffusion scale equals actual spalling depth and required fire-protection thickness.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄防火與爆裂驗證的資料來源與適用條件。核對設計火災曲線、受載狀態、含水及試件尺寸，保留溫度、爆裂和殘餘承載資料；防火工程師依核准性能目標審查，不把單一試驗照片或擴散尺度當耐火認證。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for fire and spalling verification. Check fire curve, loading, moisture and specimen scale and retain temperature, spalling and residual capacity; fire specialists review approved performance objectives rather than treating one photograph or diffusion scale as certification.

units.anchor: 耐久擴散與保護層~Durability diffusion and cover
units.title: 耐久擴散與保護層~Durability diffusion and cover
units.mechanism: 離子與水分進入混凝土的速度受孔隙結構、裂縫和接縫影響，完好材料的擴散模型不能涵蓋所有快速通道。保護層需兼顧製造公差與裂縫控制，不能只依名義厚度預測壽命。 假設純擴散尺度t≈x²/D，x由40增50 mm，其餘相同，時間比(50/40)²=1.5625；非壽命保證。 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。~Moisture and ions enter through matrix pores, cracks and joints. Intact-material diffusion misses preferential paths, so cover must consider manufacturing tolerance and cracking rather than predicting life from nominal thickness alone. Under assumed diffusion scaling t≈x²/D, increasing x from 40 to 50 mm gives time ratio 1.5625 at unchanged D, not a service-life guarantee. Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設純擴散尺度t≈x²/D，x由40增50 mm，其餘相同，時間比(50/40)²=1.5625；非壽命保證。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Under assumed diffusion scaling t≈x²/D, increasing x from 40 to 50 mm gives time ratio 1.5625 at unchanged D, not a service-life guarantee.
units.verify: 量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。~Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.
units.failure: 局部保護層不足或貫穿裂縫會主導劣化，平均厚度合格仍可能出現早期鏽蝕；以完好材料係數算出長壽命，無法彌補未處理快速通道。~Local thin cover or through-cracks can govern early corrosion despite an acceptable mean. A long life calculated with intact-material coefficients does not compensate for unaddressed preferential transport paths.
units.misconception: 完好混凝土擴散係數可以完整代表貫穿裂縫的傳輸。~An intact-concrete diffusion coefficient fully represents transport through a through-crack.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄耐久擴散與保護層的資料來源與適用條件。量測實際保護層、裂縫及吸水或遷移試驗指標，對照暴露環境和接縫細節；耐久設計需分列材料擴散與裂縫通道，評估試驗加速條件如何轉換到使用期。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for durability diffusion and cover. Measure actual cover, cracking and absorption or migration indices against exposure and joint details; separate matrix transport from crack pathways and justify transfer from accelerated tests to service conditions.

units.anchor: 環片序號與品質交接~Segment serials and quality handover
units.title: 環片序號與品質交接~Segment serials and quality handover
units.mechanism: 環片從模具、材料批次到組裝位置形成長資料鏈，任何環節失去身份都會削弱缺陷追蹤。交接應讓一個裂縫回到製造和運輸事件，也讓異常批次找到所有已安裝位置。 假設一批120片有118片可完整追溯，比例98.33%；缺失2片不能因整體比例高而自動驗收。 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。~Segments form a data chain from mould and batch to installed position. Lost identity impairs defect tracing; handover must connect a crack to manufacturing and handling events and locate every installed piece from an affected batch. If 118 of an assumed 120 segments are fully traceable, the rate is 98.33%; the remaining 2 do not qualify automatically because the overall rate is high. Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設一批120片有118片可完整追溯，比例98.33%；缺失2片不能因整體比例高而自動驗收。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If 118 of an assumed 120 segments are fully traceable, the rate is 98.33%; the remaining 2 do not qualify automatically because the overall rate is high.
units.verify: 抽取已裝環片逆查材料、試驗、尺寸、修補與運輸單，另由批號正查安裝位置；品質主管將缺漏和限制逐件簽認，數位掃碼成功不等於資料內容已通過工程審查。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。~Trace installed pieces backward through materials, tests, dimensions, repairs and transport, and trace batches forward to locations; quality leads resolve gaps individually, since successful scanning does not constitute engineering acceptance of content. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance.
units.failure: 重複序號或替換未登記會把缺陷批次定位到錯誤環，資料完整表象反而增加誤信；只有可雙向追溯的鏈才能支援針對性檢查與維護。~Duplicate serials or undocumented substitutions locate defective batches in the wrong ring, creating false confidence from apparent completeness. Only bidirectional traceability supports targeted inspection and subsequent maintenance.
units.misconception: 掃碼成功就代表環片資料內容已完成工程品質審查。~A successful barcode scan means the segment records have passed engineering quality review.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄環片序號與品質交接的資料來源與適用條件。抽取已裝環片逆查材料、試驗、尺寸、修補與運輸單，另由批號正查安裝位置；品質主管將缺漏和限制逐件簽認，數位掃碼成功不等於資料內容已通過工程審查。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for segment serials and quality handover. Trace installed pieces backward through materials, tests, dimensions, repairs and transport, and trace batches forward to locations; quality leads resolve gaps individually, since successful scanning does not constitute engineering acceptance of content.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示把環片永久受力、製造品質與暫態施工荷載連成完整驗證鏈需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why connect permanent segment behavior, manufacturing quality and temporary construction loads requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設薄環均勻外壓p=0.3 MPa、半徑3 m，環向膜力N=pR=0.9 MN/m；不含彎矩及接縫。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume uniform pressure p=0.3 MPa on a thin ring of radius 3 m; membrane force N=pR=0.9 MN/m, excluding bending and joints.

教學量化備忘：假設三個抗壓試值48、50、52 MPa，平均50 MPa；此小樣本平均不是規範特徵強度。~Teaching quantitative note: Assumed compressive results 48,50 and 52 MPa average 50 MPa; this small-sample mean is not a code-defined characteristic strength.

教學量化備忘：假設中央單點載重的三點彎曲缺口梁，殘餘荷重12 kN、跨距0.5 m、寬0.15 m、有效韌帶0.125 m，fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume a notched beam under three-point centre loading with residual load 12 kN, span 0.5 m, width 0.15 m and ligament 0.125 m; fR=3FL/(2bh²)=3.84 MPa.

教學量化備忘：假設一環6片各有同向弧長偏差0.5 mm，總偏差3 mm；獨立隨機誤差才可用平方根加總。~Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed ring has 6 segments each with a same-direction arc-length bias of 0.5 mm, total bias is 3 mm; root-sum-square applies only to independent random errors.

教學量化備忘：假設α=10⁻⁵/K、E=20 GPa、全約束降溫20 K，彈性拉應力EαΔT=4 MPa；實際徐變會改變結果。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume α=10⁻⁵/K, E=20 GPa and fully restrained cooling of 20 K; elastic tensile stress EαΔT=4 MPa, modified in reality by creep.

教學量化備忘：假設簡支示意梁總均布載重20 kN、跨2 m，Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m；曲面環片需專門分析。~Teaching quantitative note: For an assumed simply supported illustrative beam with total distributed load 20 kN over 2 m, Mmax=WL/8=5 kN·m; curved segments require specific analysis.

sources.scope: 施工工程師公開的預鑄襯砌防火分析與試驗背景；不將案例試驗條件當成所有隧道通則。
sources.scopeEn: Project engineers’ fire analysis and testing context for precast lining, without treating project test conditions as universal.

sources.title: 公路隧道設計施工技術手冊
sources.titleEn: Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels—Civil Elements
sources.scope: 官方二〇〇九年手冊書目；工程調查、掘進與襯砌設計的背景參考，非現行個案施工規格。
sources.scopeEn: Official 2009 manual record; background for investigation, excavation and lining design, not a current project specification.

sources.title: 橫貫鐵路地質縱剖面完工更新

sources.scope: 鑽孔密度、偏離路線與斷層簡化造成的地層邊界不確定性；非直接施工圖。
sources.scopeEn: Uncertainty from borehole spacing, offset and fault simplification; the section is not a direct construction drawing.

sources.title: 新阿爾卑斯鐵路連線官方介紹

sources.scopeEn: Swiss government background on the Gotthard Base Tunnel scale and rail operation.
